Use capital letters for the form entries. Where an alias appears below, use the restored value and make any required formatting changes on your device.

### Account opening

- **B01 Date** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the date you complete the form in the eight boxes, following the bank’s date order.
- **B02 Branch** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the HBZ branch handling the application.
- **B03 Account type** — Mark **CURRENT**.

**B16 Email address** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your email address directly on the form.

### B. Beneficial ownership

- **B22** — Mark **YES**.
- **B23** — Leave blank. This field applies when B22 is **NO**.

### C. FATCA

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **B24 U.S. citizenship** | Mark **NO**. |
| **B25 U.S. permanent residency or substantial physical presence** | Mark **NO**. |
| **B26 Birth in the U.S. or a U.S. territory** | **NEEDS-YOU.** Check your birthplace from B12 and mark **YES** or **NO**. |
| **B27 U.S. person for another reason** | Mark **NO**. |
| **B28 Transfers to U.S. accounts or regular directions from a U.S. address** | **NEEDS-YOU.** Confirm whether either applies and mark **YES** or **NO**. |
| **B29 Power of attorney or signing authority for someone with a U.S. address** | **NEEDS-YOU.** Confirm whether this applies and mark **YES** or **NO**. |
| **B30 In-care-of or hold-mail address, U.S. P.O. box or U.S. phone number** | **NEEDS-YOU.** Check the contact details and mail arrangements that will be on file and mark **YES** if any listed item applies, or **NO** if none does. |
